sources.scale_grouping: 'per_kind': one display scale per kind (sizes comparable between points; the clubhead sets it); 'per_point': one scale per point and kind, each point's largest radius maps to target_radius_m (sizes NOT comparable between points).
sources.target_radius_m: Displayed radius (m) of the 95th-percentile semi-axis (the former literal 0.09).
sources.outer_alpha: Alpha of the larger ellipsoid when two kinds share a centre, so the inner one shows (1 = off; the other keeps its colour alpha).
sources.min_semi_axis_m: Floor (m) of a displayed semi-axis; 0 = off (the display builder's own 5 mm clamp stays). A floored axis is not to scale.
sources.per_point_note: Panel footer shown while scale_grouping is per_point.
